contract.description: path to the JSON schema submit_<name>.json must satisfy

protocol.description: how tasks are presented to the agent (the initial state, the rewrites of what it may see or do)

cost.description: the name of the cost metric `score` emits per task (kind: mechanical)

runtime.description: what the pack's commands and the attempts execute from; undeclared, no runtime root is granted and no lock file enters env_sha

dirs.description: pack-relative directories granted read-only to the sandboxed subprocess (interpreters, installed packages)

locks.description: pack-relative globs of the files that pin those runtimes; every match is hashed into env_sha (E3)

env.description: host environment names the pack's commands may see beside PATH, HOME, the locale, TZ, TERM and TMPDIR; every other name is withheld from truth/score/materialize (E5)

auto_demote.description: a reversal or demote(...) needs a `demote` consent unless true

budget.description: held-out reveals the pack allows: lifecycle debits one per challenger run on the holdout set and one per settlement that re-scores a kept row's held-out attempts, replays the ledger's reveals on start, and refuses the next once spent; undeclared, reveals are not counted (holdout rotation is not implemented: architecture.md S7)

environment.description: where the attempts and the commands marked in_environment run; a task row may carry an `environment` column of the same shape that overrides it; undeclared, the provider's default (local: the host)

image.description: image reference the environment provider pulls

dockerfile.description: pack-relative directory holding the Dockerfile to build from (image takes precedence when both are given)

timeout_s.description: the environment's lifetime; also bounds an in_environment command the caller gives no timeout

command.description: a shell line run on the host (string), or `{ run, in_environment }` where in_environment: true runs it inside the pack's environment over the same jsonl on stdin/stdout
